text:
Sam D.: Quick sync — Pioneer POC kickoff. Need to lock success criteria, golden prompts, and any pricing/security blockers by EOD so we can ship the eval harness to the customer.
Maya P.: Copied. High level: 3 end-to-end flows (invoice extraction, policy QA, reductive summarization). For each we want precision-oriented metrics + latency SLOs.
Jonah S.: For scoring I'd propose: weighted accuracy (70% content correctness, 20% formatting, 10% hallucination rate). Pass gate = weighted >= 85% on the seedset.
Priya R.: Security Qs: customer asked about enclave/KMS usage and retention. Legal wants answers in the next 48h. @Sam D. can we confirm Private deployment option available for pilot?
Sam D.: Yes — Private option is fine. Need to confirm whether they need on-prem or VPC. I'll check tonight and update.
Maya P.: On prompts: we should surface 30 golden prompts per flow. 70/30 split between short direct and multi-step prompts. Also include negative/control prompts to test regressions.
Jonah S.: Agreed. I'll spin up the harness config. Draft scoring snippet:
```
scorer:
  type: weighted
  weights:
    correctness: 0.7
    formatting: 0.2
    hallucination_penalty: -0.1
gates:
  acceptance_threshold: 0.85
  regression_alert_delta: 0.02
```
Maya P.: Regression gate = 2% drop from baseline triggers rollback + alert to SE. That matches our standard.
Sam D.: Pricing question from buyer: pilot must be below $X / 10k tokens to be approved. Can we give an estimate for quantized model on Dedicated vs Hosted?
Jonah S.: Estimate: Dedicated w/ batching + KV cache -> ~40% lower per-token cost vs hosted. I'll run numbers for their expected QPS and return figures by tomorrow.
Priya R.: For the security questionnaire: they asked for SOC2 evidence and key rotation cadence. I have templates but need confirmation on retention periods. @Maya P. do we have retention docs to attach?
Maya P.: Yes. I'll attach the retention PDF to the thread (will email separately). Also include our standard SOC2 excerpt.
POC-bot: deploy-check: eval-harness created (id: eh-20250318-72) — seedset upload pending.
Sam D.: Excellent. Action items:
- Jonah: create eval harness, upload seedset, run baseline (due 1760083200).
- Maya: finalize golden prompt list + retention/SOC2 docs for buyer (due EOD).
- Priya: draft SCQ answers for KMS/retention (due +48h).
I'll post the consolidated acceptance doc once items are in. Any other blockers?
Maya P.: One minor: customer wants a canary rollout plan for model swaps during the pilot. We should include fallback model config in the harness (e.g., parameterize model_id, fallback_policy: region-first).
Jonah S.: I'll add model fallback and a small traffic split test harness. Will include a sample config in the repo:
```
rollout:
  primary: rwd-l7-quant
  fallback: rwd-l6-quant
  canary_split: 0.05
  monitor: latency, error_rate, quality_score
```
Priya R.: Noted. I might need an infra contact for KMS docs — @Sam D., can you loop in infra if needed?
Sam D.: Yep will loop in infra. Thanks everyone — will update thread after infra & pricing numbers. :rocket:
